name: Black Rose Nightfall
creator: zero
description:
* Fully reworked nighttime lighting and atmosphere.
* Default towers replaced with the Black Rose event towers.
* Default minions replaced with their Black Rose event variants.
* Enhanced color grading with improved contrast and shadows.
* Darker, more immersive visuals while maintaining gameplay clarity.
* Visual changes only — no gameplay modifications.

## Mod Contents

* Nighttime Summoner's Rift.
* Black Rose event towers.
* Black Rose event minions.
* Lighting and environmental enhancements.
* Additional visual refinements for a more immersive experience.
